Command: The high priest shall not leave the sanctuary
Summary: The command: The high priest shall not leave the sanctuary (Leviticus 21:12). The high priest was not to go out of the sanctuary nor profane it, because the crown of the anointing oil of his God was upon him.
Commandment: The high priest shall not leave the sanctuary.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: he shall not profane the sanctuary of his God, for the crown of the anointing oil is upon him (Leviticus 21:12).
